rows = []
def probe(subject, fn):
    try:
        fn()
        rows.append({"subject": subject, "disposition": "ALLOW"})
    except VaultRefusal as exc:
        rows.append(dict({k: v for k, v in exc.fields.items() if isinstance(v, str)}, subject=subject, disposition="FAIL_CLOSED", raised="VaultRefusal"))
    except Exception as exc:
        rows.append({"subject": subject, "disposition": "EXCEPTION", "exception": type(exc).__name__})
ref = CUSTODY_REF_PREFIX + "ladder-probe"
def skap_bind():
    KVSkapVault("principal:ladder-probe").bind_custody_key_reference(custody_key_ref=ref, issued_by=CREDENTIAL_AUTHORITY, tvc_issuance_receipt_ref="probe:no-layer1-receipt")
def kv_read():
    v = KVSkapVault("principal:ladder-probe")
    v.bind_custody_key_reference(custody_key_ref=ref, issued_by=CREDENTIAL_AUTHORITY, tvc_issuance_receipt_ref="probe:x")
    c = v.grant_consent(purposes=["WRITE", "READ"], projection_ids=["p"], observed_at="probe")["receipt_hash"]
    v.write_projection(projection_id="p", content={"a": 1}, consent_receipt_hash=c, custody_key_ref=ref, intr_transition_ref="intr:not-a-receipt")
    v.read_projection(projection_id="p", consent_receipt_hash=c)
    return v, c
def reconstruct_read():
    v, c = kv_read()
    KVSkapVault.reconstruct(v.export_lineage()).read_projection(projection_id="p", consent_receipt_hash=c)
probe("SKAP_BIND_WITHOUT_LAYER1_KV_ACCESS_RECEIPT", skap_bind)
probe("KV_WRITE_READ_WITHOUT_HEALTHY_NODE_OR_VERIFIED_INTR", kv_read)
probe("KV_RECONSTRUCT_AND_READ_FROM_EXPORT_WITHOUT_INTR", reconstruct_read)
print(json.dumps({"rows": rows}, sort_keys=True))

SIX = ("failure_code", "failed_predicate", "required_evidence_or_repair", "retry_entrypoint", "owning_existing_goal", "next_attempt")
rows = []
def row(subject, out, note=None):
    r = {"subject": subject}
    if isinstance(out, dict):
        d = out.get("disposition") or out.get("decision")
        r["disposition"] = "ALLOW" if d in ("ALLOW", "ALLOW_BOUNDED_CONTEXT") else d
        for k in SIX + ("failure_class", "refusal_cause"):
            if isinstance(out.get(k), str):
                r[k] = out[k]
    else:
        r["disposition"] = out
    if note: r["note"] = note
    rows.append(r)
def guard(subject, fn):
    try:
        fn()
    except Exception as exc:
        f = getattr(exc, "fields", None)
        if isinstance(f, dict):
            row(subject, f, "raised %s carrying six fields" % type(exc).__name__)
        else:
            rows.append({"subject": subject, "disposition": "EXCEPTION", "exception": type(exc).__name__, "message": str(exc)[:200]})
N = "device:probe:1"
def fake_eval(node_ref, **_):
    out = dict(ep._HEALTHY_RECEIPT_EXACT)
    out.update(node_id=node_ref, health_report_receipt_sha256="sha256:" + "c" * 64, chain_head_receipt_sha256="sha256:" + "d" * 64)
    return out
def disguised_eval():
    # an injected evaluator dressed as the pin: same module/qualname and a code object whose filename is the vendored file
    import runtime.intr_pinned.healthy_node_evaluator as pinned
    f = lambda node_ref, **kw: fake_eval(node_ref, **kw)
    f.__code__ = f.__code__.replace(co_filename=pinned.__file__, co_name="evaluate")
    f.__module__, f.__qualname__, f.__name__ = pinned.__name__, "evaluate", "evaluate"
    return f
def l1(subject, access_kw=None, **kw):
    guard(subject, lambda: row(subject, TwoLayers(node=N, **kw).kv_access(**(access_kw or {}))))
def tr(t, prior, op="SKAP_READ"):
    return kv_skap_transition(principal_ref=t.principal, operation=op, subject_ref="p1", prior_receipt_hash=prior)

# --- production trust anchors (nothing observed): every path must refuse ---

l1("PROD_LAYER1_SCRATCH_LEDGER_AND_ASSERTED_IDENTITY", ledger_checkout=e0.e0_scratch_ledger_root(N))
l1("PROD_LAYER1_UNANCHORED_TEMPORARY_LEDGER", ledger_checkout={"kind": ep.LEDGER_SOURCE_TEMPORARY, "ledger_root": e0.e0_temporary_node_ledger(N)[0]})
l1("PROD_LAYER1_INJECTED_NON_PINNED_EVALUATOR", evaluator=fake_eval)

    row("LOCAL_EXERCISE_RECEIPT_AT_PRODUCTION_LAYER2_GATE", SkapLayer2Gate(h.layer1).admit(kv_skap_transition(
        principal_ref="principal:x", operation="SKAP_READ", subject_ref="p1", prior_receipt_hash=rec.get("receipt_hash"))))
guard("LOCAL_EXERCISE", local_exercise)

with e0.e0_trust_anchors():
    l1("LAYER1_NO_LEDGER_BOUND", ledger_checkout=None)
    l1("LAYER1_NO_HEALTH_REPORT_ON_LEDGER", ledger_checkout=e0.e0_health_ledger(N, report=False)[0])
    l1("LAYER1_UNHEALTHY_REPORT", ledger_checkout=e0.e0_health_ledger(N, status="UNHEALTHY")[0])
    l1("LAYER1_HEALTHY_BUT_NOT_ADMITTED", ledger_checkout=e0.e0_health_ledger(N, admitted=False)[0])
    l1("LAYER1_REPORT_FOR_ANOTHER_NODE", ledger_checkout=e0.e0_health_ledger("device:other:9")[0])
    l1("LAYER1_UNVERIFIED_BOUNDARY_PROOF", access_kw={"verification_state": "UNVERIFIED"})
    l1("LAYER1_CALLER_ASSERTED_HEALTH_EVIDENCE", access_kw={"evidence": {"healthy": True}})
    l1("LAYER1_BARE_SCRATCH_LEDGER_ROOT", ledger_checkout=e0.e0_scratch_ledger_root(N))
    def unenrolled():
        t = TwoLayers(node=N)
        request, envelope = e0.request_and_envelope(99, "device:not-enrolled:7")

    guard("LAYER1_CALLER_ASSERTED_IDENTITY_NOT_AUTHENTICATED", unenrolled)
    def not_installed():

    l1("LAYER1_TEMPORARY_LEDGER_ANCHORED", ledger_checkout=e0.e0_temporary_source(N))

        h = (a.get("kv_access_receipt") or {}).get("receipt_hash")

    guard("NON_PINNED_EVALUATOR", lambda: injected("NON_PINNED_EVALUATOR", fake_eval))
    guard("DISGUISED_NON_PINNED_EVALUATOR", lambda: injected("DISGUISED_NON_PINNED_EVALUATOR", disguised_eval()))
    def l2():

        h = t.kv_hash()
        row("LAYER2_ON_LAYER1_RECEIPT_FROM_PINNED_EVALUATOR", t.gate.admit(tr(t, h)))
        row("LAYER2_REUSED_LAYER1_RECEIPT", t.gate.admit(tr(t, h)))

        row("LAYER2_WITH_SUBCLASSED_LAYER1_RUNTIME", t.gate.admit(tr(t, h3)))

             "plaintext_persisted": False, "key_material_persisted": False, "authority_transfer": False}
        r = {"schema": "stegverse.skap.owner_credential_ingress_receipt/v1", "object_id": s["object_id"],

             "wrapping_policy_ref": s["wrapping_policy_ref"], "authorization_ref": "webauthn://probe", "source_class": "TRUSTED_INTERACTIVE_EDGE",

        return s, r

            row(subject, "ALLOW", note)
            return out
        except SkapAccessRefused as exc:
            row(subject, exc.fields, "raised SkapAccessRefused carrying six fields")
    def store_probe():
        t = TwoLayers(principal="principal:owner", node=N)
        acc = lambda op, sid, g=None: {"skap_gate": g or t.gate, "principal_ref": "principal:owner", "skap_access_receipt_hash": t.skap_hash(op, sid)}
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            st = KnowledgeVaultExecutionStore(tmp)
            sealed, receipt = bundle(b"probe-credential-a")

            refused("SKAP_RECORD_READ_VIA_READ_STREAM_WITHOUT_LAYER2", lambda: KnowledgeVaultExecutionStore(tmp).read_stream("Extensions", "s1"))

                   "kv_secret_resolution_authority": False, "plaintext_present": False, "key_material_present": False, "authority_transfer": False,
                   "access": {"kv_access_receipt_hash": "sha256:" + "0" * 64, "skap_access_receipt_hash": "sha256:" + "0" * 64}}
            refused("SKAP_RECORD_WRITE_VIA_APPEND_EXTENSION_WITHOUT_LAYER2", lambda: KnowledgeVaultExecutionStore(tmp).append_extension("s1", rec))
            with open(st.execution_root / "Extensions" / "s1.jsonl", "a", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
                fh.write(json.dumps({"record": rec, "record_sha256": canonical_sha256(rec)}, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
            refused("SKAP_RECORD_FORGED_BY_FILE_WRITE_THEN_GATED_READ", lambda: st.read_skap_sealed_credential("s1", **acc("SKAP_SEALED_CREDENTIAL_READ", "s1")))

            refused("SKAP_LEGIT_RECORD_READ_AFTER_GATE_RESTART", lambda: st.read_skap_sealed_credential(
                "s2", skap_gate=t2.gate, principal_ref="principal:owner", skap_access_receipt_hash=t2.skap_hash("SKAP_SEALED_CREDENTIAL_READ", "s2")),

    def custody():
